decision.title: Approve Q2 marketing budget increase
decision.description: Increase Q2 digital marketing spend from $500K to $750K to capture emerging market opportunity in APAC region.
decision.rationale: Council recommendation accepted with CRO hedging condition incorporated.

agents.perspective: Risk assessment, currency exposure, hedging requirements
Regulatory compliance, data privacy, jurisdiction analysis

messages.content: ROI projections show 3.2x return based on Q1 APAC traction. Budget increase is within quarterly variance authority.
messages.reasoning: Q1 APAC revenue grew 47% QoQ with current spend. Incremental $250K targets Singapore and Japan markets.

messages.content: Market opportunity is real but currency risk in APAC is elevated. Recommend hedging 40% of incremental spend.
messages.reasoning: USD/SGD volatility at 18-month high. Unhedged FX exposure on $250K exceeds 5% risk appetite threshold.

messages.content: No regulatory barriers identified. Data privacy compliance confirmed for Singapore (PDPA), Japan (APPI), Australia (Privacy Act).
messages.reasoning: Marketing data processing agreements in place for all three jurisdictions. Cross-border transfer mechanisms confirmed.

votes.rationale: Strong ROI case within budget authority
Approve only with FX hedging on 40% of incremental spend
votes.conditions: Hedge 40% of incremental APAC spend against USD/SGD and USD/JPY

votes.rationale: No legal or regulatory impediments in target jurisdictions

dissent.content: Unhedged FX exposure exceeds risk appetite for emerging market spend. If hedging is not implemented, this dissent should be escalated to the board risk committee.

biasesDetected.evidence: CFO's 3.2x ROI figure anchored discussion; alternative scenarios not fully explored
